validity.recommendation: Fix Capacity units: 35 is million cubic METERS/day (MMcm/d), not MMcf/d. Set CapacityUnits=MMcm/d (or convert 35 MMcm/d -> ~1,236 MMcf/d if keeping MMcf/d). Also deep-fill blank Diameter=48 in and Length~100 km (Iranian export section).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and well-documented. Iran-Iraq gas export pipeline (Charmaleh, Ilam -> Naft Shahr border -> Mansourieh/Mansuriya power plant, Diyala, then on to Baghdad). Iran began pipeline gas exports to Iraq mid-2017 (RFERL, 'Iran Begins Pipeline Gas Exports To Iraq After Years Of Delay'). Corroborated as an active supply route by iraqinews (flows ~20 MMcm/d). CLASSIFICATION: correct — a cross-border gas TRANSMISSION export trunk (not gathering/process/oil). DUPLICATE: none. No other roster row is an Iran->Iraq export line; GulfPub Iran gas roster (49 features) contains NO Iran-Iraq line at all (it lists Iran-Kuwait, Iran-Armenia, Iran-Oman, Pakistan link, but nothing to Iraq). The auto-flagged fuzzy GulfPub matches ('Sirri Island - Bandar Abbas' proposed, 'Sirik - Kuh Mobarak' construction) are spurious offshore/southern lines, unrelated. So NOT a duplicate/relabel. ATTRIBUTION: endpoints Iran->Diyala,Iraq are correct; built BOT by Hirbodan for National Iranian Gas Company (owner/operator NIGC/NIGEC) — owner/operator refs out of scope for this worklist. SPEC (the concern): sheet Capacity=35.00 MMcf/d is a UNITS ERROR. worldpipelines states this Baghdad line was designed 'initially 4 million m3/d, scaling to 35 million m3/d' — i.e. 35 MMcm/d, matching the sheet's number '35' but the unit label MMcf/d is wrong by ~35x (35 MMcm/d ~= 1,236 MMcf/d; 35 MMcf/d ~= 1 MMcm/d is implausibly tiny for a power-plant supply deal). offshore-energy gives 4->40 MMcm/d; 2013 contract 40 MMcm/d (~1.4 bcf/d); iraqinews ~20 MMcm/d actual flows. All independent sources report tens of MMcm/d, none report MMcf/d. Blank Length/Diameter deep-filled (see fills): 100 km 48-inch corroborated by three independent sources (offshore-energy, worldpipelines, digital-oil-gas-map at 98.4 km). Start 2017 confirmed.

fills.researcher_notes: Diameter was blank in GEM. Three independent sources agree 48-inch: worldpipelines (48 in), offshore-energy (48-inch), digital-oil-gas-map GIS product (98.4km 48" Charmaleh-Naftshahr).

Length was blank. ~100 km is the IRANIAN export section (Charmaleh, Ilam -> Naft Shahr border): worldpipelines 100 km, offshore-energy 100 km, digital-oil-gas-map 98.4 km — three independent agree. CAVEAT (tier medium): this is the Iranian side only; total cross-border length to the Mansourieh/Baghdad delivery point is longer (Iraqi extension + ~7 km to Mansourieh cited separately). If GEM length should represent the whole cross-border line, 100 km understates it; use 100 km for the Iranian trunk section and flag the total as uncertain.

UNITS CORRECTION, not a value change. The '35' is million cubic METERS/day: worldpipelines states the Baghdad line scales to '35 million m3/d'. Sheet's CapacityUnits=MMcf/d is wrong (would be ~1 MMcm/d, implausible). Proposed: keep Capacity=35.00 but set CapacityUnits=MMcm/d. Corroborating scale: offshore-energy 4->40 MMcm/d; iraqinews ~20 MMcm/d actual flows; 2013 contract 40 MMcm/d. No source reports capacity in MMcf/d.

routes.end_name: Mansourieh (Mansuriya) power plant, Diyala province, Iraq (line continues toward Baghdad)

waypoints.name: Naft Shahr, Kermanshah province, Iran (Iran-Iraq border crossing)

routes.corridor_desc: Iranian export trunk runs ~100 km westward from Charmaleh (fed by the Kohdasht-Charmaleh line) near Eyvan in Ilam province to the Naft Shahr / Qasr-e-Shirin border area of Kermanshah province, then crosses into Diyala province, Iraq, delivering to the Mansourieh power plant and continuing toward the Baghdad power-plant cluster. Endpoints are firmly named by independent sources; the exact traced polyline is not in hand (a commercial GIS route product exists for the Charmaleh-Naftshahr section), so the corridor is well-bounded but coordinates below are approximate centroids of the named places (marked approximate), not surveyed points.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from three independent sources: Charmaleh (Ilam) -> Naft Shahr border (offshore-energy, digital-oil-gas-map, worldpipelines), extension to Mansourieh power plant in Diyala and onward to Baghdad (offshore-energy, worldpipelines). Coordinates are approximate centroids of the named towns/facilities (Charmaleh ~near Eyvan 33.83N 46.31E; Naft Shahr ~34.02N 45.51E; Mansuriya ~33.98N 44.95E) — defensible from named places, NOT fabricated survey points; treat as corridor anchors, not a route. Sheet currently has meaningless Start='Asia'/End='Asia'; real endpoints replace those.
